# The Path

A winding path through morning mist,
Where dewdrops hang on leaves sun-kissed,
And birdsong fills the quiet air,
With melodies beyond compare.

Each step I take, the world unfolds,
In whispered greens and burnished golds,
The journey calls, I don't know where,
But beauty waits for me out there.
